{{Quote|Various records note that the first Matukai was a human female from the world of Karvoss II who discovered her ability to touch the Force while practicing a form of meditative martial arts.|Tionne Solusar, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''female''' hailed from the<ref name="JvS" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Karvoss system/Legends|Karvoss system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karvoss II]]<ref name="JvS" /> and lived at some point between [[3996 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="Dates">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'' establishes that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] lived at some point following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates to [[3996 BBY]]. In addition, ''Jedi vs. Sith'' states she was alive "many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before" [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] established the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].</ref>
